rationale: B is more useful because it gives a concrete path: investigate incidents, identify root causes, then do targeted hardening or subsystem replacement instead of a full rewrite. It directly engages the live alternatives and explains why auth rewrites are unusually risky while also rejecting inaction. A names a plausible option, but the excerpt lacks a clear alternative comparison, actionable next steps, or usable revisit triggers; its quantitative support is only gestured at, not actually informative. B is weak on explicit numbers and formal uncertainty handling, but still better supports a careful decision-maker.
